<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#031A31"/>

    <g transform="translate(362,10)">

  <!-- Header -->

    <text x="48" y="80" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile views analytics</text>
